searchLog: Checked data/target-companies.json's frontier-lab and ai-startup tiers (Anthropic Applied AI Architect/TPM, OpenAI Emerging Talent, Databricks APM New Grad, Scale AI New Grad, Sierra APX, Mistral, Ramp) plus searched for Dec-2026-grad-friendly Forward Deployed Engineer roles (Palantir, Applied Intuition) against life/PIPELINE.md to avoid resurfacing applied/rejected companies (Stripe, IBM, Notion, Anthropic Fellows/Claude Corps, etc.). Promising leads for Palantir and Applied Intuition Forward-Deployed-Engineer-New-Grad (Dec 2026/2027) roles turned up only via WebSearch snippets and third-party ATS mirrors (General Catalyst, a16z, Lever, Built In) — none could be fetched and confirmed live from a primary source, so per the verification rule they are omitted rather than included unverified. Zero verified opportunities is the honest result this run.
